issue_request: FHIR-26825 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested a date range on MedicationKnowledge.cost so old prices, price types, bands, and current price applicability could be represented; the resolution text named MedicationKnowledge.cost.period.
initial_application: Commit 603de50396 listed FHIR-26825 and added MedicationKnowledge.cost.effectiveDate as a 0..* Period with date-range short and definition text in the MedicationKnowledge spreadsheet. Later source rework commit 33b409a4b6 preserved that element in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source uses the published element name effectiveDate rather than the resolution's suggested period path, but it carries the requested semantics. Searches found no direct Zulip, Confluence, or later Jira evidence requiring a rename; the only Jira neighborhood hit was FHIR-31365, a separate packaging cost/identifier cardinality issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Renaming the already-published effectiveDate element to period would be a breaking source change unsupported by the discovered evidence.
